entities.name: Konrāds Kalējs
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Konrāds Kalējs was a Latvian soldier who was a Nazi collaborator and an alleged war criminal during World War II. He gained notoriety for evading calls for his prosecution across four countries, more than once under the threat of deportation.
